page_title: INT 2-1 GEN | Inter v Genoa 04/03/2024, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+5' That's the end of the match.

90+1' What a wasted opportunity by Marko Arnautovic (Inter)! He creates some space for himself inside the penalty box and unleashes a decent strike towards the bottom right corner, but Josep Martinez makes an astonishing save to thwart him.
90' 4 min. of stoppage-time to be played.
90' Vitinha (Genoa) launches into a thunderous tackle on his opponent and the referee blows his whistle for a foul.
89' Simone Inzaghi (Inter) picks up a yellow card for unsporting behaviour after the half-time whistle. He should have gone straight into the dressing room instead.
88' That's the end of the game for Stefano Sabelli, who is replaced by Caleb Ekuban (Genoa).
84' The corner from Kristjan Asllani (Inter) is intercepted by Josep Martinez.

84' He should have scored! Marko Arnautovic (Inter) gathered a short pass deep inside the box but took too long to shoot, allowing the defender to make the block. Inter will have a chance to score from a corner kick.

83' Nicolo Barella (Inter) blew a promising scoring opportunity. He received a fine cross deep inside the box, but his shot flew just over the bar. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Genoa.
82' Genoa can’t profit from the corner as the defence clear the ball upfield.
81' One of the defenders reacts at the last minute to brilliantly block a pass from Kevin Strootman (Genoa). The referee signals a corner kick to Genoa.
79' Nicolo Barella (Inter) sends a cross into the box, but the opposition's defence clears the ball away to eliminate the danger.
76' We are about to witness a subsitution. Marko Arnautovic (Inter) for Lautaro Martinez.
74' Genoa failed to take advantage of the corner as the opposition's defence was alert and averted the threat.
73' Simone Inzaghi has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Yann Bisseck (Inter) replacing Benjamin Pavard.
73' A lofted cross from Stefano Sabelli (Genoa) is unsuccessful as the opponent's defence quickly clears the ball out of the penalty area. Corner kick. Genoa will have an opportunity.
72' Good movement by Albert Gudmundsson (Genoa), but he can't find any of his teammates as the cross is poor. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Inter.
71' The ball is whipped in from the corner by Albert Gudmundsson (Genoa), but one of the defenders gets it clear.

70' Mateo Retegui (Genoa) attempts to find his teammate with a pass from outside the box, but the opposition's defence is quick to react and thwarts the attack. The referee blows his whistle, Genoa are awarded a corner kick.
69' Lautaro Martinez (Inter) receives a yellow card from the referee, but it seems like a very harsh decision.
66' A goal, which was scored by Vitinha (Genoa), was disallowed due to offside.
65' Simone Inzaghi prepares a substitution. Federico Dimarco is replaced by Francesco Acerbi (Inter).
65' Substitution. Marcus Thuram (Inter) on for Alexis Sanchez.
65' Djed Spence (Genoa) skips past his man but can't keep the ball in play. The ball goes out of play and Inter will have a goal kick.
64' Stefano Sabelli (Genoa) slaloms his way past challenges, but an opposing player does well to get the ball away.
63' Alberto Gilardino decides to make a substitution. Junior Messias will be replaced by Vitinha (Genoa).
63' We are about to witness a substitution. Djed Spence (Genoa) is replacing Aaron Martin.
61' This yellow card was deserved. The tackle by Johan Vasquez (Genoa) was quite harsh and Giovanni Ayroldi didn't hesitate to show him a yellow card.
60' This corner kick is taken with a short pass by Federico Dimarco (Inter).

59' Carlos Augusto (Inter) runs onto the ball inside the box and smashes it towards the left side of the goal. It's a great effort but an even better save from Josep Martinez, who tips the ball around the post.
57' Kristjan Asllani (Inter) takes the corner, but one of the defenders reacts well and rises highest to head the ball away.

54' 2 - 1 Goal! Johan Vasquez (Genoa) picks up the ball from a rebound and from the edge of the box he unleashes a low shot into the bottom right corner. Yann Sommer is unable to keep the ball out of the net. It's 2:1.
52' Matteo Darmian (Inter) controls a cross inside the box and sends a low drive towards the left post, but one of the defenders reacts superbly to block his effort.
51' Lautaro Martinez (Inter) lets fly with a decent effort from the edge of the box that flashes just wide of the right post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Genoa.
48' The ball is cleared after Lautaro Martinez (Inter) attempted to dribble past an opposing player.
47' Kevin Strootman (Genoa) has tested the patience of referee Giovanni Ayroldi and goes into the book for a previous late challenge.
46' Junior Messias (Genoa) sends a pass into the box, but his attempt is thwarted and cleared.
46' There will be a change on the pitch for the second half. Simone Inzaghi probably wasn't satisfied with the performance of Denzel Dumfries. He is replaced by Matteo Darmian (Inter).
46' The need to improve in the second half has brought about a change. Morten Frendrup comes off for Kevin Strootman (Genoa).
46' The referee blows his whistle to signal the start of the second half.
45+4' Giovanni Ayroldi blows his whistle to signal the end of the first-half action.
45+2' Inter take a short corner instead of sending the ball into the penalty area.

45+1' Henrikh Mkhitaryan (Inter) connects with an accurate pass inside the box and fires the ball to the bottom right corner, but one of the defending players steps in to block the effort. Inter earn a corner.
45+1' Johan Vasquez (Genoa) clips an inviting cross into the box, but there's no one in a position to get on the end of it.
45' The fourth official shows 3 min. of added time.
45' Junior Messias (Genoa) plays a through ball but overhits it.
40' Kristjan Asllani (Inter) takes a mid-range shot, but the ball sails high over the bar. The ball goes out of play and Genoa will have a goal kick.
38' 2 - 0 GOAL! That’s a perfect strike from the spot by Alexis Sanchez (Inter) into the top right hand corner, giving goalkeeper Josep Martinez no chance!
37' Alexis Sanchez (Inter) is going to take the penalty!
35' Here comes the VAR decision. YES, it's a penalty!

35' It's been a while since that incident in the box, but the ref must have received some information as he makes the VAR signal. He's going to review that earlier penalty shout! What a chance for Inter.
34' Nicolo Barella (Inter) receives a sweet pass inside the box, but his effort on goal is blocked by the defender. The referee points to the corner flag and Inter will take a corner.
30' 1 - 0 Kristjan Asllani (Inter) receives a brilliant pass inside the box from Alexis Sanchez, and beats the goalkeeper with a shot into the roof of the net. He makes it 1:0.
28' Lautaro Martinez (Inter) races towards goal but the defender gets back well to make a challenge.

26' Mateo Retegui (Genoa) attempts to convert a lofted cross as he jumps high and heads the ball down to the middle of the goal. Yann Sommer shows his brilliant reflexes and pulls off a glorious save to stop the ball from hitting the net.
23' Nicolo Barella (Inter) pounces on a great cross inside the box, but lashes his powerful first-time shot inches over the bar. The ball goes out of play and Genoa will have a goal kick.
22' Giovanni Ayroldi shows a yellow card to Denzel Dumfries (Inter) for his blatant foul.
20' Morten Frendrup (Genoa) is booked after bringing down an opponent. Giovanni Ayroldi had an easy-decision to make.

18' Mateo Retegui (Genoa) outbattles the defender to win the ball from the corner, but he can't quite control his header and sends it just wide of the right post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Inter.
18' The ball is out of play and the linesman points at the corner flag. Corner to Genoa.
17' A fantastic block by a defender means that the corner from Genoa comes to nothing.

15' Federico Dimarco (Inter) collects a great pass inside the box and misses a golden opportunity. His low drive is headed for the bottom left corner, but the goalkeeper pulls off a marvellous diving save and denies him.
13' Another attempt to send the ball beyond the defence by Benjamin Pavard (Inter) is thwarted and cleared to safety.
7' Lautaro Martinez (Inter) goes on a solo run, but he fails to create a chance as an opposition player blocks him.
6' Benjamin Pavard (Inter) attempted to pick out a free teammate inside the box, but Josep Martinez comes off the line to clear the ball away.
4' The Inter players are exchanging some short passes to try and open up the opposition’s defence and hit them swiftly on the break.
2' Federico Dimarco (Inter) plays a through ball but overhits it. The ball goes out of play and Genoa will have a goal kick.
1' The referee blows his whistle and we are underway.
Genoa will kick-off.
The referee of today's match will be Giovanni Ayroldi.
